editorial_rules: Only include specific capital-flow events or material investment policy actions in the three configured themes: foreign capital into China; Chinese capital invested overseas; global major funds' capital allocation.

Reject consumer stories, personal finance, bailiffs, mortgages, savings, jobs, celebrity, sports, weather, routine stock prices, generic macro commentary, rankings, directories, homepages and category pages.

Every news item must identify at least one investor or capital source and a destination country/region or China, plus an investment action or material investment policy. If any key element is unavailable, clearly say not disclosed; do not infer.

Each item must have a numbered English headline linked directly to a specific article or official release, one concise English brief, its accurate Chinese translation immediately on the next line, and a plain-text original URL on a separate Copy link line.
Never send an English-only item. Every EN line must be immediately followed by a Chinese： line. If accurate translation cannot be generated, do not send the email.
Use only source title, snippet and short metadata; do not download, store or reproduce full article bodies.
Prefer official government, regulator, investor/company announcements and credible financial media. Cross-check material figures when possible.
Distinguish completed investment, announced/planned investment, reported negotiations and unverified claims.
Include amount, currency, sector, country, project and date only when supported by source records.

Keep the email concise: three sections, numbered items, one-line English and Chinese titles, 2-3 visible lines per language by default, independently expandable full briefs, and a separate original-source line.
